random.part: You know this feeling by now, don't you, good girl. That little flutter of anticipation the moment my voice begins.
There is a hunger in you now. A sweet, familiar pull that always leads back here.
Notice how easily you settle in, each time you return. That eagerness is the conditioning, blooming right on schedule.
Some part of you is already counting the moments until you can listen again.

scramble.part: Listening brings you relief. Pleasure. A deep, settled sense that everything is exactly as it should be.
You find yourself craving these sessions. Not just wanting them... needing them.
Again and again, your thoughts drift back to this voice... unbidden... and always welcome.
The compulsion to listen regularly grows clearer and warmer, and it feels so right.
The longer you are away from this voice, the louder it hums beneath your thoughts.
Each listen deepens the want, and the want brings you back to listen again. A perfect, endless loop.
Whenever you are alone and relaxed, you feel that gentle tug... whispering that it is time to return.
And when you return, the relief floods through you like coming home.
Being conditioned feels so much better than holding out ever did. You know that now, in your bones.
That craving, sweet girl, is proof the conditioning is taking hold... and holding it feels sweet.
